summary.plain: An array of closed water tanks on a Mexican volcano that sense the faint flashes of light left by particles from gamma-ray and cosmic-ray showers as they pass through the water.
summary.technical: Water-Cherenkov extensive-air-shower array at 4100 m on Sierra Negra, Mexico; full-array operations since March 2015. Tank count and individual tank dimensions are not recorded in this pass (source PDFs with those specifications could not be read this session).

technology.note: Named for its detection technique; exact tank count/geometry not sourced this session (see notes).
technology.value: Array of closed water-Cherenkov detector tanks continuously sampling extensive air showers from gamma rays and cosmic rays.
